items.question: Trong câu "A stack and a queue are both ordered collections that only let you add and remove items at specific ends.", từ "collection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stack and a queue are both ordered collections that only let you add and remove items at specific ends.", what does "collection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collection /kəˈlekʃn/ (danh từ): tập hợp, bộ sưu tập. "An ordered collection" = một tập hợp có thứ tự; stack và queue đều là tập hợp phần tử.
items.explanationEn: collection /kəˈlekʃn/ (noun): a group of things. "An ordered collection" is a group whose items keep a sequence; stacks and queues are both collections.

items.question: Trong câu "A stack and a queue are both ordered collections that only let you add and remove items at specific ends.", từ "specific" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stack and a queue are both ordered collections that only let you add and remove items at specific ends.", what does "specific" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: specific /spəˈsɪfɪk/ (tính từ): xác định, cụ thể. "At specific ends" = ở những đầu xác định; trái nghĩa với "general".
items.explanationEn: specific /spəˈsɪfɪk/ (adjective): particular, clearly defined. "At specific ends" means at particular, fixed ends; the opposite of "general".

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript has no built-in Stack or Queue class.", từ "built-in" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript has no built-in Stack or Queue class.", what does "built-in" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: built-in /ˌbɪlt ˈɪn/ (tính từ): có sẵn, tích hợp sẵn. "A built-in class/function" = lớp/hàm có sẵn trong ngôn ngữ, không cần tự viết.
items.explanationEn: built-in /ˌbɪlt ˈɪn/ (adjective): included as standard. "A built-in class or function" ships with the language, so you do not write it yourself.

items.question: Trong câu "You either use an array with the right methods or write a small class backed by a linked list.", từ "backed by" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You either use an array with the right methods or write a small class backed by a linked list.", what does "backed by" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: backed by /bækt baɪ/ (cụm từ): được xây dựng dựa trên. "A stack backed by an array" = stack dùng mảng làm nơi lưu trữ bên dưới.
items.explanationEn: backed by /bækt baɪ/ (phrase): built on top of. "A stack backed by an array" uses an array as its underlying storage.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are valid implementations of the same ADT — but, as we will see, the wrong choice of array methods silently turns an O(1) operation into O(n).", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are valid implementations of the same ADT — but, as we will see, the wrong choice of array methods silently turns an O(1) operation into O(n).", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
options: bản hiện thực, cách cài đặt
optionsEn: a concrete way of building it
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): bản hiện thực, cách cài đặt. "An implementation of an ADT" = một cách cài đặt cụ thể cho kiểu dữ liệu trừu tượng.
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (noun): a concrete way of building it. "An implementation of an ADT" is one concrete piece of code that realises the abstract type.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are valid implementations of the same ADT — but, as we will see, the wrong choice of array methods silently turns an O(1) operation into O(n).", từ "silently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are valid implementations of the same ADT — but, as we will see, the wrong choice of array methods silently turns an O(1) operation into O(n).", what does "silently" (adverb) mean?
options: một cách âm thầm, không báo
items.explanation: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (trạng từ): một cách âm thầm, không báo. "Silently fail / silently turn into" = âm thầm hỏng/biến thành mà không có lỗi báo ra.
items.explanationEn: silently /ˈsaɪləntli/ (adverb): without any warning or notice. "Silently fails" or "silently turns into" means it happens with no error or warning.

items.question: Trong câu "Restricting access is the point: because you only touch the ends, every core operation can be O(1).", từ "restrict" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Restricting access is the point: because you only touch the ends, every core operation can be O(1).", what does "restrict" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (động từ): giới hạn, hạn chế. "Restrict access to" = hạn chế quyền truy cập vào; danh từ là "restriction".
items.explanationEn: restrict /rɪˈstrɪkt/ (verb): to limit. "Restrict access to" means to limit who or what can reach something; the noun is "restriction".

items.question: Trong câu "Besides push, pop (returns null/undefined when empty) and peek, most stacks expose isEmpty() or size.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Besides push, pop (returns null/undefined when empty) and peek, most stacks expose isEmpty() or size.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
options: cung cấp ra ngoài, để lộ ra
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): cung cấp ra ngoài, để lộ ra. "Expose a method/API" = cung cấp phương thức cho bên ngoài dùng.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to make available to users. "Expose a method or an API" means to make it available for outside code to call.

items.question: Trong câu "A stack reverses order: push a, b, c and popping everything yields c, b, a.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A stack reverses order: push a, b, c and popping everything yields c, b, a.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): cho ra, tạo ra (kết quả). "X yields Y" = X cho ra kết quả Y; cũng gặp trong generator của JavaScript.
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce as a result. "X yields Y" means X produces Y as a result; you also meet it in JavaScript generators.

items.question: Trong câu "Whenever a problem needs "the most recent unfinished thing", think stack.", từ "recent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Whenever a problem needs "the most recent unfinished thing", think stack.", what does "recent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recent /ˈriːsnt/ (tính từ): gần đây, mới nhất. "The most recent" = cái mới nhất, gần đây nhất; stack luôn trả về phần tử mới nhất.
items.explanationEn: recent /ˈriːsnt/ (adjective): having happened lately. "The most recent" is the latest one; a stack always hands back the newest item.

items.question: Trong câu "This is why deep recursion can overflow the stack.", từ "overflow" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is why deep recursion can overflow the stack.", what does "overflow" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (động từ): tràn (vượt quá sức chứa). "Overflow the stack" = làm tràn ngăn xếp; lỗi "stack overflow" xảy ra khi đệ quy quá sâu.
items.explanationEn: overflow /ˌəʊvəˈfləʊ/ (verb): to exceed the capacity of. "Overflow the stack" means to exceed its capacity; a "stack overflow" error comes from too-deep recursion.

items.question: Trong câu "Iterative DFS on trees and graphs uses an explicit stack instead of recursion.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Iterative DFS on trees and graphs uses an explicit stack instead of recursion.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (tính từ): tường minh, rõ ràng. "An explicit stack" = stack do mình tự tạo ra; trái nghĩa với "implicit" (call stack ngầm).
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪsɪt/ (adjective): stated or created directly. "An explicit stack" is one you create yourself; the opposite of the "implicit" call stack.

items.question: Trong câu "Parsing: matching brackets, evaluating expressions, validating HTML tags.", từ "parse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parsing: matching brackets, evaluating expressions, validating HTML tags.", what does "parse" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to analyse text into its structure
items.explanation: parse /pɑːz/ (động từ): phân tích cú pháp. "Parse JSON / parse an expression" = phân tích chuỗi thành cấu trúc có nghĩa; "parser" = bộ phân tích.
items.explanationEn: parse /pɑːz/ (verb): to analyse text into its structure. "Parse JSON" or "parse an expression" means to turn text into a meaningful structure; a "parser" does it.

items.question: Trong câu "A classic interview problem — are the brackets balanced?", từ "balanced" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A classic interview problem — are the brackets balanced?", what does "balanced" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: balanced /ˈbælənst/ (tính từ): cân bằng, khớp đủ cặp. "Balanced brackets" = mọi dấu mở đều có dấu đóng tương ứng, đúng thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: balanced /ˈbælənst/ (adjective): properly matched in pairs. "Balanced brackets" means every opener has a matching closer in the right order.

items.question: Trong câu "Each character is pushed or popped at most once: O(n) time, O(n) space in the worst case (all openers).", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each character is pushed or popped at most once: O(n) time, O(n) space in the worst case (all openers).", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất; đi cặp với "best case", "average case".
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable situation. "In the worst case" means in the least favourable input; it pairs with "best case" and "average case".

items.question: Trong câu "push and pop touch only the last slot, so nothing else has to move.", từ "slot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push and pop touch only the last slot, so nothing else has to move.", what does "slot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a position that holds a value
items.explanation: slot /slɒt/ (danh từ): ô, vị trí chứa. "The last slot of the array" = ô cuối của mảng; "time slot" lại là khung giờ.
items.explanationEn: slot /slɒt/ (noun): a position that holds a value. "The last slot of the array" is its final position; a "time slot" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", từ "amortized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", what does "amortized" (adjective) mean?
options: được tính trung bình dàn trải
items.explanation: amortized /ˈæmətaɪzd/ (tính từ): được tính trung bình dàn trải. "Amortized O(1)" = trung bình mỗi thao tác O(1) dù thỉnh thoảng có thao tác tốn kém.
items.explanationEn: amortized /ˈæmətaɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many operations. "Amortized O(1)" means O(1) on average per operation even if a few single calls are costly.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", từ "occasionally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", what does "occasionally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: occasionally /əˈkeɪʒnəli/ (trạng từ): thỉnh thoảng. "Occasionally" = thỉnh thoảng, không thường xuyên; tính từ là "occasional".
items.explanationEn: occasionally /əˈkeɪʒnəli/ (adverb): now and then. "Occasionally" means now and then, not often; the adjective is "occasional".

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", từ "reallocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", what does "reallocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reallocate /riːˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát lại (bộ nhớ). "Reallocate memory/storage" = cấp phát lại vùng nhớ, thường lớn hơn, rồi chép dữ liệu sang.
items.explanationEn: reallocate /riːˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to assign memory again. "Reallocate memory" means to reserve a new, usually larger, block and copy data into it.

items.question: Trong câu "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", từ "constant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is amortized O(1): occasionally the engine reallocates the backing storage and copies everything, but averaged over many pushes the cost is constant.", what does "constant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒnstənt/ (tính từ): không đổi, cố định. "Constant time" = thời gian không đổi, tức O(1); "constant" còn nghĩa là liên tục.
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒnstənt/ (adjective): not changing in size. "Constant time" means time that does not grow, i.e. O(1); "constant" can also mean continual.

items.question: Trong câu "A singly linked list (see the linked-list topic) gives worst-case O(1) operations if we add and remove at the head:", từ "singly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A singly linked list (see the linked-list topic) gives worst-case O(1) operations if we add and remove at the head:", what does "singly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: singly /ˈsɪŋɡli/ (trạng từ): theo một chiều, đơn. "Singly linked list" = danh sách liên kết đơn (mỗi nút chỉ trỏ tới nút sau); đối lập "doubly".
items.explanationEn: singly /ˈsɪŋɡli/ (adverb): in one direction only. "Singly linked list" means each node links only to the next; the contrast is "doubly".

items.question: Trong câu "Why the head and not the tail?", từ "tail" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why the head and not the tail?", what does "tail" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the first node of a list
the reverse side of a coin
the final node of a list
items.explanation: tail /teɪl/ (danh từ): phần đuôi, nút cuối. "The tail of a linked list" = nút cuối danh sách; đi cặp với "head".
items.explanationEn: tail /teɪl/ (noun): the final node of a list. "The tail of a linked list" is its final node; it pairs with "head".

items.question: Trong câu "Adding at the tail is cheap if you keep a last pointer, but removing the tail of a singly linked list means walking from the head to find the new last node — O(n).", từ "cheap" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Adding at the tail is cheap if you keep a last pointer, but removing the tail of a singly linked list means walking from the head to find the new last node — O(n).", what does "cheap" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: cheap /tʃiːp/ (tính từ): tốn ít tài nguyên, nhanh. "A cheap operation" trong lập trình = thao tác tốn ít thời gian/bộ nhớ; ngược lại là "expensive".
items.explanationEn: cheap /tʃiːp/ (adjective): costing little work. In programming a "cheap operation" costs little time or memory; the opposite is "expensive".

items.question: Trong câu "Array — contiguous memory, cache-friendly, no per-node object, simplest code.", từ "contiguous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Array — contiguous memory, cache-friendly, no per-node object, simplest code.", what does "contiguous" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: next to each other in a block
items.explanation: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (tính từ): liền kề, liên tục nhau. "Contiguous memory" = vùng nhớ liền một khối; khác với "contagious" (dễ lây).
items.explanationEn: contiguous /kənˈtɪɡjuəs/ (adjective): next to each other in a block. "Contiguous memory" is one unbroken block; do not confuse it with "contagious".

items.question: Trong câu "Occasional O(n) resize spike.", từ "spike" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Occasional O(n) resize spike.", what does "spike" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: spike /spaɪk/ (danh từ): sự tăng vọt đột ngột. "A latency spike / CPU spike" = mức tăng vọt đột ngột trên biểu đồ.
items.explanationEn: spike /spaɪk/ (noun): a sudden sharp rise. "A latency spike" or "CPU spike" is a sudden sharp jump on a chart.

items.question: Trong câu "In JavaScript, and in interviews, a plain array with push/pop is the normal choice.", từ "plain" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In JavaScript, and in interviews, a plain array with push/pop is the normal choice.", what does "plain" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: plain /pleɪn/ (tính từ): bình thường, đơn giản. "A plain array/object" = mảng/đối tượng thông thường, không bọc thêm gì.
items.explanationEn: plain /pleɪn/ (adjective): simple, with nothing added. "A plain array or object" is an ordinary one with nothing wrapped around it.

items.question: Trong câu "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", từ "reach for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", what does "reach for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔː/ (cụm từ): chọn dùng, tìm đến. "Reach for a tool" = chọn dùng công cụ đó khi cần; nghĩa đen là với tay lấy.
items.explanationEn: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔː/ (phrase): to choose to use. "Reach for a tool" means to pick it when you need it; literally it means to stretch out a hand.

items.question: Trong câu "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", từ "guaranteed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", what does "guaranteed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (tính từ): được đảm bảo chắc chắn. "Guaranteed latency" = độ trễ được đảm bảo, không bao giờ vượt ngưỡng.
items.explanationEn: guaranteed /ˌɡærənˈtiːd/ (adjective): certain to be met. "Guaranteed latency" is a delay that is promised never to exceed a limit.

items.question: Trong câu "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (danh từ): độ trễ. "Low latency" = độ trễ thấp; thường nói cùng "throughput" (thông lượng).
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (noun): delay before a response. "Low latency" means little delay; it is often discussed with "throughput".

items.question: Trong câu "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", từ "from scratch" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reach for the linked-list version when you need guaranteed per-operation latency or are asked to implement the structure from scratch.", what does "from scratch" (phrase) mean?
options: từ đầu, từ con số không
items.explanation: from scratch /frəm ˈskrætʃ/ (cụm từ): từ đầu, từ con số không. "Build/implement from scratch" = tự làm từ đầu, không dùng thứ có sẵn.
items.explanationEn: from scratch /frəm ˈskrætʃ/ (phrase): starting from nothing. "Build or implement from scratch" means to start from nothing, without ready-made parts.

items.question: Trong câu "Items join at the back and leave from the front.", từ "join" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Items join at the back and leave from the front.", what does "join" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to become part of a group
items.explanation: join /dʒɔɪn/ (động từ): gia nhập, vào (hàng). "Join the queue" = vào hàng đợi; trong SQL "join" lại là nối bảng.
items.explanationEn: join /dʒɔɪn/ (verb): to become part of a group. "Join the queue" means to get into the line; in SQL "join" means combining tables.

items.question: Trong câu "A queue preserves order: items come out in exactly the order they went in.", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A queue preserves order: items come out in exactly the order they went in.", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): giữ nguyên, bảo toàn. "Preserve order" = giữ nguyên thứ tự; "a stable sort preserves order" cũng hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep unchanged. "Preserve order" means to keep the sequence unchanged; "a stable sort preserves order" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "Task and job queues — background jobs, uploads, print spoolers, message brokers.", từ "broker" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Task and job queues — background jobs, uploads, print spoolers, message brokers.", what does "broker" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a middle service passing things on
items.explanation: broker /ˈbrəʊkə/ (danh từ): bên trung gian chuyển tiếp. "Message broker" (như RabbitMQ, Kafka) = hệ thống trung gian nhận và chuyển tiếp tin nhắn.
items.explanationEn: broker /ˈbrəʊkə/ (noun): a middle service passing things on. A "message broker" such as RabbitMQ or Kafka sits in the middle, receiving and forwarding messages.

items.question: Trong câu "Breadth-first search (BFS) — visit nodes level by level.", từ "breadth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Breadth-first search (BFS) — visit nodes level by level.", what does "breadth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: breadth /bredθ/ (danh từ): chiều rộng. "Breadth-first" = duyệt theo chiều rộng; đối lập "depth-first" (chiều sâu). Đừng nhầm với "breath".
items.explanationEn: breadth /bredθ/ (noun): width, extent across. "Breadth-first" means exploring across a level first; the opposite is "depth-first". Do not confuse with "breath".

items.question: Trong câu "The JavaScript event loop — callbacks wait in task queues and run in arrival order.", từ "arrival" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The JavaScript event loop — callbacks wait in task queues and run in arrival order.", what does "arrival" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: arrival /əˈraɪvl/ (danh từ): sự đến nơi. "In arrival order" = theo thứ tự đến; đó chính là FIFO.
items.explanationEn: arrival /əˈraɪvl/ (noun): the act of getting there. "In arrival order" means in the order things came in, which is exactly FIFO.

items.question: Trong câu "Buffers — keystrokes, network packets, rate limiters.", từ "buffer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Buffers — keystrokes, network packets, rate limiters.", what does "buffer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: buffer /ˈbʌfə/ (danh từ): vùng đệm (dữ liệu). "Buffer" = vùng nhớ tạm giữ dữ liệu trước khi xử lý; "buffer zone" là vùng đệm địa lý.
items.explanationEn: buffer /ˈbʌfə/ (noun): temporary storage for data. A "buffer" holds data temporarily before it is processed; a "buffer zone" is a geographic sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The obvious array queue is push to enqueue and shift to dequeue (or unshift + pop).", từ "obvious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The obvious array queue is push to enqueue and shift to dequeue (or unshift + pop).", what does "obvious" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: easy to see or think of
items.explanation: obvious /ˈɒbviəs/ (tính từ): hiển nhiên, dễ thấy. "The obvious solution" = cách giải dễ nghĩ ra nhất, nhưng chưa chắc là tốt nhất.
items.explanationEn: obvious /ˈɒbviəs/ (adjective): easy to see or think of. "The obvious solution" is the first one you think of, not necessarily the best.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are FIFO, but one of the two operations always works on the front of the array, and the front is expensive:", từ "expensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are FIFO, but one of the two operations always works on the front of the array, and the front is expensive:", what does "expensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (tính từ): tốn kém tài nguyên, chậm. "An expensive operation" = thao tác tốn nhiều thời gian/bộ nhớ; ngược với "cheap".
items.explanationEn: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (adjective): costly in time or memory. "An expensive operation" costs a lot of time or memory; the opposite of "cheap".

items.question: Trong câu "An array's elements live at numbered indices, so removing index 0 forces all others to be renumbered: O(n).", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An array's elements live at numbered indices, so removing index 0 forces all others to be renumbered: O(n).", what does "index" (noun) mean?
options: chỉ số, vị trí đánh số
optionsEn: a list at the back of a book
items.explanation: index /ˈɪndeks/ (danh từ): chỉ số, vị trí đánh số. "Index" số nhiều là "indices" hoặc "indexes"; "at index 0" = ở vị trí 0.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪndeks/ (noun): a numbered position. The plural of "index" is "indices" or "indexes"; "at index 0" means at position 0.

items.question: Trong câu "Draining a queue of n items with shift therefore costs about n + (n−1) + … + 1 = O(n²).", từ "drain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draining a queue of n items with shift therefore costs about n + (n−1) + … + 1 = O(n²).", what does "drain" (verb) mean?
options: lấy hết ra cho đến rỗng
items.explanation: drain /dreɪn/ (động từ): lấy hết ra cho đến rỗng. "Drain a queue/buffer" = lấy hết phần tử ra cho đến khi rỗng.
items.explanationEn: drain /dreɪn/ (verb): to empty by removing everything. "Drain a queue or buffer" means to remove items until it is empty.

items.question: Trong câu "Draining a queue of n items with shift therefore costs about n + (n−1) + … + 1 = O(n²).", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Draining a queue of n items with shift therefore costs about n + (n−1) + … + 1 = O(n²).", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː/ (trạng từ): do đó, vì vậy. "Therefore" dùng để nêu kết luận rút ra từ ý trước; văn phong trang trọng hơn "so".
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðeəfɔː/ (adverb): as a result. "Therefore" introduces a conclusion drawn from what came before; it is more formal than "so".

items.question: Trong câu "Engines sometimes optimise small cases, but you cannot rely on that.", từ "optimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Engines sometimes optimise small cases, but you cannot rely on that.", what does "optimise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make run as well as possible
items.explanation: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (động từ): tối ưu hóa. "Optimise" (Anh) = "optimize" (Mỹ); danh từ "optimisation".
items.explanationEn: optimise /ˈɒptɪmaɪz/ (verb): to make run as well as possible. "Optimise" is British spelling of "optimize"; the noun is "optimisation".

items.question: Trong câu "Engines sometimes optimise small cases, but you cannot rely on that.", từ "rely on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Engines sometimes optimise small cases, but you cannot rely on that.", what does "rely on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, trông cậy vào. "You cannot rely on it" = không thể trông cậy vào điều đó; tính từ "reliable".
items.explanationEn: rely on /rɪˈlaɪ ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on. "You cannot rely on it" means you cannot depend on it; the adjective is "reliable".

items.question: Trong câu "The fix without a linked list: never remove from the front — just move a head index forward and compact occasionally.", từ "compact" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The fix without a linked list: never remove from the front — just move a head index forward and compact occasionally.", what does "compact" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (động từ): dồn gọn, nén lại. "Compact the array" = dồn phần tử còn sống lại, bỏ chỗ trống; danh từ "compaction".
items.explanationEn: compact /kəmˈpækt/ (verb): to squeeze into less space. "Compact the array" means to pack live items together and drop the gaps; the noun is "compaction".

items.question: Trong câu "With a singly linked list we keep two pointers, first and last.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With a singly linked list we keep two pointers, first and last.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə/ (danh từ): con trỏ (tham chiếu). "Keep a pointer to the last node" = giữ một tham chiếu tới nút cuối.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪntə/ (noun): a reference to a location. "Keep a pointer to the last node" means holding a reference to it.

items.question: Trong câu "Enqueue at the tail, dequeue at the head — the head is the only end where removal is O(1).", từ "removal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Enqueue at the tail, dequeue at the head — the head is the only end where removal is O(1).", what does "removal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: removal /rɪˈmuːvl/ (danh từ): sự loại bỏ. "Removal" là danh từ của "remove"; "insertion and removal" = chèn và xóa.
items.explanationEn: removal /rɪˈmuːvl/ (noun): the act of taking out. "Removal" is the noun of "remove"; "insertion and removal" is a common pair.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic bug is forgetting to reset last when the final node leaves.", từ "reset" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic bug is forgetting to reset last when the final node leaves.", what does "reset" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set back to a start value
items.explanation: reset /ˌriːˈset/ (động từ): đặt lại về ban đầu. "Reset a variable to null" = gán lại biến về giá trị ban đầu.
items.explanationEn: reset /ˌriːˈset/ (verb): to set back to a start value. "Reset a variable to null" means to set it back to its starting value.

items.question: Trong câu "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", từ "attach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", what does "attach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to add a file to an email
items.explanation: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (động từ): gắn vào, nối vào. "Attach A to B" = gắn A vào B; "attach a file" = đính kèm tệp.
items.explanationEn: attach /əˈtætʃ/ (verb): to join onto. "Attach A to B" means to join A onto B; "attach a file" is the email sense.

items.question: Trong câu "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", từ "detached" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", what does "detached" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: detached /dɪˈtætʃt/ (tính từ): bị tách rời. "A detached node" = nút đã bị tách khỏi danh sách; "a detached house" = nhà riêng biệt.
items.explanationEn: detached /dɪˈtætʃt/ (adjective): no longer connected. "A detached node" has been cut off from the list; "a detached house" stands alone.

items.question: Trong câu "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", từ "effectively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "last then still points at the removed node, the next enqueue attaches the new node to that detached node, and first stays null — the value is effectively lost.", what does "effectively" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in a way that works well
items.explanation: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (trạng từ): trên thực tế, coi như. "Effectively lost" = coi như mất; "work effectively" lại là làm việc hiệu quả.
items.explanationEn: effectively /ɪˈfektɪvli/ (adverb): in practice, as good as. "Effectively lost" means lost in practice; "work effectively" is the other sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The most important algorithmic use is BFS.", từ "algorithmic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most important algorithmic use is BFS.", what does "algorithmic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: algorithmic /ˌælɡəˈrɪðmɪk/ (tính từ): thuộc về thuật toán. "Algorithmic problem" = bài toán thuật toán; danh từ gốc "algorithm".
items.explanationEn: algorithmic /ˌælɡəˈrɪðmɪk/ (adjective): relating to algorithms. An "algorithmic problem" is one about algorithms; the root noun is "algorithm".

items.question: Trong câu "Because a queue is FIFO, nodes are processed in order of distance from the start, so the first time BFS reaches the target it has found the fewest hops in an unweighted graph:", từ "hop" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because a queue is FIFO, nodes are processed in order of distance from the start, so the first time BFS reaches the target it has found the fewest hops in an unweighted graph:", what does "hop" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hop /hɒp/ (danh từ): bước nhảy (qua một cạnh). "The fewest hops" = ít bước qua cạnh nhất; mạng máy tính cũng dùng "hop" cho mỗi router.
items.explanationEn: hop /hɒp/ (noun): one step along an edge. "The fewest hops" means the fewest edges crossed; networking also counts each router as a "hop".

items.question: Trong câu "Because a queue is FIFO, nodes are processed in order of distance from the start, so the first time BFS reaches the target it has found the fewest hops in an unweighted graph:", từ "unweighted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because a queue is FIFO, nodes are processed in order of distance from the start, so the first time BFS reaches the target it has found the fewest hops in an unweighted graph:", what does "unweighted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unweighted /ʌnˈweɪtɪd/ (tính từ): không có trọng số. "Unweighted graph" = đồ thị mà mọi cạnh coi như bằng nhau; đối lập "weighted".
items.explanationEn: unweighted /ʌnˈweɪtɪd/ (adjective): having no edge costs. An "unweighted graph" treats every edge as equal; the opposite is "weighted".

items.question: Trong câu "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): thay thế, đổi sang. "Swap A for B" = thay A bằng B; "swap two elements" = đổi chỗ hai phần tử.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to replace one with another. "Swap A for B" means to replace A with B; "swap two elements" means exchange their places.

items.question: Trong câu "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", từ "reachable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", what does "reachable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (tính từ): có thể đi tới được. "Reachable node" = nút có đường đi tới từ điểm bắt đầu.
items.explanationEn: reachable /ˈriːtʃəbl/ (adjective): able to be got to. A "reachable node" is one with a path to it from the start.

items.question: Trong câu "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", từ "no longer" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", what does "no longer" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: no longer /nəʊ ˈlɒŋɡə/ (cụm từ): không còn nữa. "No longer + động từ" = không còn làm gì nữa, ví dụ "no longer supported".
items.explanationEn: no longer /nəʊ ˈlɒŋɡə/ (phrase): not any more. "No longer" plus a verb means something stopped being true, e.g. "no longer supported".

items.question: Trong câu "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", từ "guarantee" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Swap the queue for a stack and the same loop becomes an iterative DFS: it still visits every reachable node, but it no longer guarantees the shortest path.", what does "guarantee" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (động từ): đảm bảo chắc chắn. "Guarantee the shortest path" = đảm bảo chắc chắn tìm được đường ngắn nhất.
items.explanationEn: guarantee /ˌɡærənˈtiː/ (verb): to make certain. "Guarantee the shortest path" means it is certain to find the shortest route.

items.question: Trong câu "Graph traversal itself is covered in later topics.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graph traversal itself is covered in later topics.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua. "Tree/graph traversal" = duyệt qua các nút; động từ "traverse".
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜːsl/ (noun): visiting every node in turn. "Tree or graph traversal" means visiting the nodes; the verb is "traverse".

items.question: Trong câu "Graph traversal itself is covered in later topics.", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Graph traversal itself is covered in later topics.", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌvə/ (động từ): đề cập, trình bày. "Be covered in later topics" = được trình bày ở các chủ đề sau.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌvə/ (verb): to deal with a subject. "Covered in later topics" means the subject is dealt with there.

items.question: Trong câu "A deque ("deck") allows insertion and removal at both ends: pushFront, pushBack, popFront, popBack, all O(1).", từ "insertion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A deque ("deck") allows insertion and removal at both ends: pushFront, pushBack, popFront, popBack, all O(1).", what does "insertion" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: insertion /ɪnˈsɜːʃn/ (danh từ): sự chèn vào. "Insertion" là danh từ của "insert"; "insertion sort" = sắp xếp chèn.
items.explanationEn: insertion /ɪnˈsɜːʃn/ (noun): the act of putting in. "Insertion" is the noun of "insert"; compare "insertion sort".

items.question: Trong câu "It can act as a stack (use one end) or a queue (use both ends).", từ "act as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It can act as a stack (use one end) or a queue (use both ends).", what does "act as" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to star in a film with
items.explanation: act as /ˈækt æz/ (cụm từ): đóng vai trò như. "Act as X" = đóng vai trò X; tương tự "serve as".
items.explanationEn: act as /ˈækt æz/ (phrase): to serve the role of. "Act as X" means to perform the role of X; similar to "serve as".

items.question: Trong câu "A doubly linked list with head and tail — O(1) at both ends because each node knows its predecessor.", từ "predecessor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A doubly linked list with head and tail — O(1) at both ends because each node knows its predecessor.", what does "predecessor" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the previous holder of a job
items.explanation: predecessor /ˈpriːdɪsesə/ (danh từ): phần tử đứng trước. "Predecessor" = phần tử liền trước; đối lập "successor" (liền sau).
items.explanationEn: predecessor /ˈpriːdɪsesə/ (noun): the item just before. "Predecessor" is the item just before; its opposite is "successor".

items.question: Trong câu "A circular buffer (ring buffer) — an array whose front index wraps around with %.", từ "circular" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A circular buffer (ring buffer) — an array whose front index wraps around with %.", what does "circular" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: circular /ˈsɜːkjələ/ (tính từ): vòng tròn, quay vòng. "Circular buffer" = bộ đệm vòng; "circular reasoning" lại là lập luận luẩn quẩn.
items.explanationEn: circular /ˈsɜːkjələ/ (adjective): forming a loop. A "circular buffer" loops around; "circular reasoning" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "A circular buffer (ring buffer) — an array whose front index wraps around with %.", từ "wrap around" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A circular buffer (ring buffer) — an array whose front index wraps around with %.", what does "wrap around" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to go back to the start
items.explanation: wrap around /ˌræp əˈraʊnd/ (cụm từ): quay vòng về đầu. "The index wraps around" = chỉ số chạy hết cuối thì quay lại 0.
items.explanationEn: wrap around /ˌræp əˈraʊnd/ (phrase): to go back to the start. "The index wraps around" means after the end it returns to 0.

items.question: Trong câu "Pushes are amortized O(1) (doubling copies everything rarely); pops are O(1); space O(n).", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pushes are amortized O(1) (doubling copies everything rarely); pops are O(1); space O(n).", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreəli/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. "Rarely" = hiếm khi; trái nghĩa "frequently", "often".
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreəli/ (adverb): not often. "Rarely" means not often; the opposite of "frequently".

items.question: Trong câu "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", từ "monotonic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", what does "monotonic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: monotonic /ˌmɒnəˈtɒnɪk/ (tính từ): đơn điệu (luôn tăng hoặc giảm). "Monotonic stack/deque" = cấu trúc giữ phần tử luôn tăng hoặc giảm dần.
items.explanationEn: monotonic /ˌmɒnəˈtɒnɪk/ (adjective): always rising or always falling. A "monotonic stack or deque" keeps its items always increasing or decreasing.

items.question: Trong câu "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", từ "bounded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", what does "bounded" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (tính từ): có giới hạn kích thước. "A bounded queue" = hàng đợi có sức chứa tối đa; đối lập "unbounded".
items.explanationEn: bounded /ˈbaʊndɪd/ (adjective): having a fixed maximum size. A "bounded queue" has a maximum capacity; the opposite is "unbounded".

items.question: Trong câu "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", từ "entry" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", what does "entry" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: entry /ˈentri/ (danh từ): mục, bản ghi. "A history/log entry" = một mục trong lịch sử hoặc nhật ký.
items.explanationEn: entry /ˈentri/ (noun): one recorded item. A "history entry" or "log entry" is one recorded item.

items.question: Trong câu "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", từ "scheduler" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Deques power the monotonic deque trick for "sliding window maximum" in O(n), bounded undo histories that drop the oldest entry, and work-stealing task schedulers.", what does "scheduler" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scheduler /ˈʃedjuːlə/ (danh từ): bộ lập lịch. "Task scheduler" = bộ lập lịch quyết định tác vụ nào chạy lúc nào.
items.explanationEn: scheduler /ˈʃedjuːlə/ (noun): a component that plans work. A "task scheduler" decides which task runs and when.

items.question: Trong câu "Cost: a single dequeue can be O(n) when it triggers a transfer, but each element is pushed onto the inbox once, moved once, and popped once.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cost: a single dequeue can be O(n) when it triggers a transfer, but each element is pushed onto the inbox once, moved once, and popped once.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (động từ): kích hoạt, gây ra. "Trigger an event/transfer" = kích hoạt; danh từ "trigger" trong database cũng rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡə/ (verb): to set off. "Trigger an event" means to set it off; a database "trigger" is the noun sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Over any sequence of m operations the total work is O(m), so enqueue and dequeue are amortized O(1).", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Over any sequence of m operations the total work is O(m), so enqueue and dequeue are amortized O(1).", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (danh từ): chuỗi, dãy liên tiếp. "A sequence of operations" = một chuỗi thao tác theo thứ tự.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiːkwəns/ (noun): a series in order. "A sequence of operations" is a series of them in order.

items.question: Trong câu "The critical rule: only refill when the outbox is empty.", từ "critical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The critical rule: only refill when the outbox is empty.", what does "critical" (adjective) mean?
options: then chốt, cực kỳ quan trọng
items.explanation: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (tính từ): then chốt, cực kỳ quan trọng. "Critical rule/bug" = quy tắc/lỗi then chốt; "critical of someone" = chỉ trích.
items.explanationEn: critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/ (adjective): essential, decisive. A "critical rule" or "critical bug" is decisive; "critical of someone" means finding fault.

items.question: Trong câu "The critical rule: only refill when the outbox is empty.", từ "refill" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The critical rule: only refill when the outbox is empty.", what does "refill" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refill /ˌriːˈfɪl/ (động từ): đổ đầy lại. "Refill the outbox" = nạp đầy lại stack outbox từ inbox.
items.explanationEn: refill /ˌriːˈfɪl/ (verb): to fill again. "Refill the outbox" means to fill it again from the inbox.

items.question: Trong câu "The reverse exercise — a stack from two queues — is possible too, but one of push or pop must cost O(n).", từ "exercise" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The reverse exercise — a stack from two queues — is possible too, but one of push or pop must cost O(n).", what does "exercise" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exercise /ˈeksəsaɪz/ (danh từ): bài tập. "A coding exercise" = bài tập lập trình; "do exercise" = tập thể dục.
items.explanationEn: exercise /ˈeksəsaɪz/ (noun): a practice task. A "coding exercise" is a practice task; "do exercise" means physical training.

items.question: Trong câu "Both are ADTs — defined by behaviour, not storage.", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both are ADTs — defined by behaviour, not storage.", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (danh từ): hành vi, cách hoạt động. "Behaviour" (Anh) = "behavior" (Mỹ); ADT được định nghĩa bởi hành vi các thao tác.
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (noun): the way something acts. "Behaviour" is British spelling of "behavior"; an ADT is defined by how its operations act.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognise the pattern: most recent / nesting / undo / DFS → stack; arrival order / level by level / BFS / scheduling → queue; both ends or sliding window → deque.", từ "recognise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognise the pattern: most recent / nesting / undo / DFS → stack; arrival order / level by level / BFS / scheduling → queue; both ends or sliding window → deque.", what does "recognise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recognise /ˈrekəɡnaɪz/ (động từ): nhận ra. "Recognise a pattern" = nhận ra dạng bài; kỹ năng quan trọng khi phỏng vấn.
items.explanationEn: recognise /ˈrekəɡnaɪz/ (verb): to identify. "Recognise a pattern" means to identify the problem type, a key interview skill.

items.question: Trong câu "Recognise the pattern: most recent / nesting / undo / DFS → stack; arrival order / level by level / BFS / scheduling → queue; both ends or sliding window → deque.", từ "nesting" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Recognise the pattern: most recent / nesting / undo / DFS → stack; arrival order / level by level / BFS / scheduling → queue; both ends or sliding window → deque.", what does "nesting" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: nesting /ˈnestɪŋ/ (danh từ): sự lồng nhau. "Nesting" = cấu trúc lồng nhau như ngoặc trong ngoặc; "nested loops" = vòng lặp lồng.
items.explanationEn: nesting /ˈnestɪŋ/ (noun): placing one inside another. "Nesting" is one structure inside another, like brackets in brackets; compare "nested loops".

items.question: Trong câu "A queue preserves order and models task processing, buffers and BFS.", từ "model" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A queue preserves order and models task processing, buffers and BFS.", what does "model" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to work as a fashion model
items.explanation: model /ˈmɒdl/ (động từ): mô phỏng, biểu diễn. "X models Y" = X dùng để biểu diễn/mô hình hóa Y.
items.explanationEn: model /ˈmɒdl/ (verb): to represent in a system. "X models Y" means X is used to represent Y.

items.question: Trong câu "Implementation choice matters: the right array methods or a linked list keep operations O(1); shift/unshift quietly make them O(n).", từ "quietly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Implementation choice matters: the right array methods or a linked list keep operations O(1); shift/unshift quietly make them O(n).", what does "quietly" (adverb) mean?
options: âm thầm, không ai để ý
items.explanation: quietly /ˈkwaɪətli/ (trạng từ): âm thầm, không ai để ý. "Quietly make it O(n)" = âm thầm làm chậm mà không có cảnh báo; gần nghĩa "silently".
items.explanationEn: quietly /ˈkwaɪətli/ (adverb): without being noticed. "Quietly make it O(n)" means it slows down unnoticed; close to "silently".

items.question: Trong câu "Two stacks can simulate a queue with amortized O(1) operations.", từ "simulate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two stacks can simulate a queue with amortized O(1) operations.", what does "simulate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: simulate /ˈsɪmjuleɪt/ (động từ): giả lập, mô phỏng. "Simulate a queue" = giả lập hành vi của queue bằng cấu trúc khác.
items.explanationEn: simulate /ˈsɪmjuleɪt/ (verb): to imitate how something works. "Simulate a queue" means to reproduce its behaviour with other structures.
